name: curl
purpose: Send HTTP requests from the terminal, such as calling an API endpoint.
explanation: Transfers data from or to a server. Used in C04 to demonstrate a raw API call returning JSON without any GUI.
whenToUse: To test API endpoints or download scripts/data from URLs in the terminal.
commonMistakes: Omitting the protocol (http:// or https://) when calling a URL.
explanationOfOutput: Shows the simulated terminal response when running `curl` in a standard Unix-like shell.

relevantConcepts.title: C04 — CLI, GUI, API & Error Feedback

commonErrors: zsh: command not found: curl (if not installed or missing from PATH)
